<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Capital Investment Appraisal Simulator</title>
<style>
:root{
  --bg:#f4f7fb; --card:#ffffff; --ink:#1f2937; --muted:#64748b; --line:#d9e2ec;
  --blue:#1769aa; --purple:#7c3aed; --orange:#ea580c; --green:#15803d; --gray:#475569;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
body{margin:0;font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink)}
.wrap{max-width:1240px;margin:0 auto;padding:24px}
.hero{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#0f4f82,#1769aa);color:#fff;border-radius:18px;padding:24px 28px;box-shadow:0 10px 28px rgba(23,105,170,.18)}
.hero h1{margin:0 0 8px;font-size:30px}
.hero p{margin:0;line-height:1.5;opacity:.96}
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:410px 1fr;gap:20px;margin-top:20px}
.card{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:18px;box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(16,24,40,.05)}
h2{font-size:20px;margin:0 0 14px}
h3{font-size:16px;margin:18px 0 10px}
.form-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px}
label{display:block;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:700;margin:7px 0 5px}
input{width:100%;padding:9px 10px;border:1px solid #cbd5e1;border-radius:8px;font-size:13px}
.actions{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;margin-top:16px}
button,.linkbtn{border:0;border-radius:9px;padding:10px 14px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;text-decoration:none;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:13px}
.primary{background:var(--blue);color:#fff}.primary:hover{background:#0f4f82}
.secondary{background:var(--purple);color:#fff}.secondary:hover{background:#6d28d9}
.orange{background:var(--orange);color:#fff}.orange:hover{background:#c2410c}
.green{background:var(--green);color:#fff}.green:hover{background:#166534}
.gray{background:var(--gray);color:#fff}.gray:hover{background:#334155}
.links{display:grid;gap:10px;margin-top:18px}
.links .linkbtn:first-child{background:#0f766e;color:#fff}
.links .linkbtn:last-child{background:#be123c;color:#fff}
.hint{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.5;margin-top:10px}
.kpis{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:10px;margin-bottom:15px}
.kpi{background:#f8fafc;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:13px}
.kpi small{display:block;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:5px}.kpi strong{font-size:17px}
.table-wrap{overflow:auto;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px}
table{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;min-width:820px}
th,td{padding:9px 10px;border-bottom:1px solid #e6edf3;text-align:right;font-size:12px}
th:first-child,td:first-child{text-align:left}
thead th{background:#edf4fa;color:#153d5d}
.total td{font-weight:800;background:#fbfcfe}
.positive td{font-weight:800;background:#ebf8f2;color:#126847}
.negative td{font-weight:800;background:#fff7ed;color:#9a3412}
.calc-steps{display:none;margin-top:16px}.calc-steps.show{display:block}
.step{border-left:4px solid var(--blue);background:#f6fbff;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:8px;margin:8px 0}
.panel{display:none;margin-top:16px;background:#0b1220;color:#dce7f2;border-radius:12px;padding:16px;overflow:auto}.panel.show{display:block}
pre{white-space:pre-wrap;margin:0;font:12px/1.5 Consolas,monospace}
.note{margin-top:16px;background:#fff9e9;border:1px solid #f3d48a;border-radius:10px;padding:12px 14px;font-size:13px;line-height:1.5}
footer{text-align:center;color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;margin-top:22px}
@media(max-width:950px){.grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.kpis{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
@media(max-width:540px){.wrap{padding:12px}.kpis{grid-template-columns:1fr}.form-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.hero h1{font-size:24px}}

.brandbar{
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:18px;
  background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;
  padding:14px 18px;margin-bottom:18px;box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(16,24,40,.05)
}
.brand-left{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px}
.brand-logo{height:58px;width:auto;display:block}
.brand-title{font-size:24px;font-weight:800;color:#0f4f82;line-height:1.1}
.brand-sub{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:4px}
.brand-contact{text-align:right;font-size:13px;line-height:1.7}
.brand-contact a{color:#1769aa;text-decoration:none;font-weight:700}
.brand-contact a:hover{text-decoration:underline}
footer a{color:#1769aa;text-decoration:none;font-weight:700}
@media(max-width:700px){
  .brandbar{flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start}
  .brand-contact{text-align:left}
  .brand-logo{height:50px}
  .brand-title{font-size:21px}
}

</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="wrap">

<section class="brandbar">
  <div class="brand-left">
    <img class="brand-logo" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="BISP Logo">
    <div>
      <div class="brand-title">BISP Training</div>
      <div class="brand-sub">Capital Investment Appraisal &amp; Oracle EPM Learning Simulator</div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="brand-contact">
    <div><strong>Call Us:</strong> <a href="tel:+917694095404">+91 7694095404</a></div>
    <div><strong>Website:</strong> <a href="http://www.bisptraining.com" target="_blank" rel="noopener">www.bisptraining.com</a></div>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="hero">
  <h1>Capital Investment Appraisal Simulator</h1>
  <p>Interactive version of the capital investment appraisal plan. Enter the initial investment, yearly cash inflows and discount rate to calculate payback, discounted payback, NPV, IRR and profitability index.</p>
</section>

<div class="grid">
<aside class="card">
  <h2>Investment Inputs</h2>

  <div class="form-grid">
    <div><label>Initial Investment / Cash Out</label><input id="initial" type="number" value="360000"></div>
    <div><label>Fixed Cost of Capital %</label><input id="discount" type="number" step="0.01" value="20"></div>
    <div><label>Year 1 Cash In</label><input id="cf1" type="number" value="60000"></div>
    <div><label>Year 2 Cash In</label><input id="cf2" type="number" value="95000"></div>
    <div><label>Year 3 Cash In</label><input id="cf3" type="number" value="120000"></div>
    <div><label>Year 4 Cash In</label><input id="cf4" type="number" value="180000"></div>
    <div><label>Year 5 Cash In</label><input id="cf5" type="number" value="200000"></div>
  </div>

  <h3>Estimated Inflation Rates</h3>
  <div class="form-grid">
    <div><label>Y1 %</label><input id="inf1" type="number" step="0.01" value="3"></div>
    <div><label>Y2 %</label><input id="inf2" type="number" step="0.01" value="4"></div>
    <div><label>Y3 %</label><input id="inf3" type="number" step="0.01" value="4"></div>
    <div><label>Y4 %</label><input id="inf4" type="number" step="0.01" value="3"></div>
    <div><label>Y5 %</label><input id="inf5" type="number" step="0.01" value="2"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="actions">
    <button class="primary" onclick="calculate()">Calculate</button>
    <button class="secondary" onclick="toggleCalc()">Show Calculation</button>
    <button class="orange" onclick="toggleEssbase()">Essbase Calculation</button>
    <button class="green" onclick="exportExcel()">Export in Excel</button>
    <button class="gray" onclick="resetAll()">Reset</button>
  </div>

  <div class="links">
    <a class="linkbtn" target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://sonalji2022.github.io/BISP-Trainings/EPM%20Skills%20Assessment.html">EPM Skills Assessment</a>
    <a class="linkbtn" target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://sonalji2022.github.io/BISP-Trainings/BISP_FCCS_Oracle%20Certification%20Practice.html">FCCS Oracle Certification Practice</a>
  </div>

  <p class="hint">All results are generated only after you click <b>Calculate</b>.</p>
</aside>

<main class="card">
  <h2>Capital Investment Appraisal Results</h2>

  <div class="kpis">
    <div class="kpi"><small>NPV</small><strong id="kNPV">–</strong></div>
    <div class="kpi"><small>IRR</small><strong id="kIRR">–</strong></div>
    <div class="kpi"><small>Payback</small><strong id="kPayback">–</strong></div>
    <div class="kpi"><small>Profitability Index</small><strong id="kPI">–</strong></div>
  </div>

  <div class="table-wrap">
    <table id="resultTable">
      <thead>
        <tr><th>Year</th><th>Cash Out</th><th>Cash In</th><th>Net Cash Movement</th><th>Discount Factor</th><th>Present Value</th><th>Cumulative Cash</th></tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody id="tbody">
        <tr><td colspan="7" style="text-align:center;padding:28px;color:#64748b;">Click <b>Calculate</b> to generate the investment appraisal.</td></tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>
  </div>

  <div id="summaryTableWrap" class="table-wrap" style="margin-top:16px">
    <table>
      <thead><tr><th>Investment Report</th><th>Result</th></tr></thead>
      <tbody id="summaryBody">
        <tr><td>Payback Period</td><td>–</td></tr>
        <tr><td>Discounted Payback Period</td><td>–</td></tr>
        <tr><td>Rate of Return / IRR</td><td>–</td></tr>
        <tr><td>NPV</td><td>–</td></tr>
        <tr><td>Profitability Index</td><td>–</td></tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>
  </div>

  <div id="calcSteps" class="calc-steps"></div>
  <div id="essbasePanel" class="panel"><pre id="essbaseCode"></pre></div>

  <div class="note">
    <b>Concept:</b> Capital investment appraisal compares a project’s initial cash outflow with future cash inflows. Payback measures how quickly the investment is recovered, NPV discounts future cash flows at the cost of capital, IRR estimates the discount rate where NPV is approximately zero, and the Profitability Index compares PV of inflows with the initial investment.
  </div>
</main>
</div>

<footer>BISP Training • <a href="http://www.bisptraining.com" target="_blank" rel="noopener">www.bisptraining.com</a> • Call Us: +91 7694095404</footer>
</div>

<script>
const defaults={initial:360000,discount:20,cf1:60000,cf2:95000,cf3:120000,cf4:180000,cf5:200000,inf1:3,inf2:4,inf3:4,inf4:3,inf5:2};
let model=null;

function n(id){return parseFloat(document.getElementById(id).value)||0}
function fmt(x){return Number(x).toLocaleString(undefined,{maximumFractionDigits:2})}

function npvAtRate(rate,cashflows){
  let npv=-n('initial');
  for(let i=0;i<cashflows.length;i++) npv += cashflows[i]/Math.pow(1+rate,i+1);
  return npv;
}

function calcIRR(cashflows){
  let low=-0.99, high=10, mid=0;
  for(let i=0;i<200;i++){
    mid=(low+high)/2;
    const val=npvAtRate(mid,cashflows);
    if(Math.abs(val)<0.0001) break;
    if(val>0) low=mid; else high=mid;
  }
  return mid;
}

function paybackPeriod(cfs){
  let remaining=n('initial');
  for(let i=0;i<cfs.length;i++){
    if(cfs[i]>=remaining) return i + remaining/cfs[i];
    remaining-=cfs[i];
  }
  return null;
}

function discountedPayback(cfs,rate){
  let remaining=n('initial');
  for(let i=0;i<cfs.length;i++){
    const pv=cfs[i]/Math.pow(1+rate,i+1);
    if(pv>=remaining) return i + remaining/pv;
    remaining-=pv;
  }
  return null;
}

function calculate(){
  const cfs=[n('cf1'),n('cf2'),n('cf3'),n('cf4'),n('cf5')];
  const rate=n('discount')/100;

  const rows=[];
  let cumulative=-n('initial');
  rows.push({year:'Initial',cashOut:n('initial'),cashIn:0,net:-n('initial'),df:1,pv:-n('initial'),cum:cumulative});

  let pvInflows=0;
  for(let i=0;i<5;i++){
    const df=1/Math.pow(1+rate,i+1);
    const pv=cfs[i]*df;
    pvInflows+=pv;
    cumulative+=cfs[i];
    rows.push({year:'Year '+(i+1),cashOut:0,cashIn:cfs[i],net:cfs[i],df,pv,cum:cumulative});
  }

  const npv=pvInflows-n('initial');
  const irr=calcIRR(cfs);
  const payback=paybackPeriod(cfs);
  const dpayback=discountedPayback(cfs,rate);
  const pi=pvInflows/n('initial');

  model={rows,npv,irr,payback,dpayback,pi,pvInflows,cfs,rate};

  document.getElementById('tbody').innerHTML=rows.map((r,i)=>`
    <tr class="${r.pv>=0?'':'negative'}">
      <td>${r.year}</td>
      <td>${fmt(r.cashOut)}</td>
      <td>${fmt(r.cashIn)}</td>
      <td>${fmt(r.net)}</td>
      <td>${i===0?'1.0000':r.df.toFixed(4)}</td>
      <td>${fmt(r.pv)}</td>
      <td>${fmt(r.cum)}</td>
    </tr>`).join('');

  const pb=payback===null?'Not recovered':payback.toFixed(2)+' years';
  const dpb=dpayback===null?'Not recovered':dpayback.toFixed(2)+' years';

  document.getElementById('summaryBody').innerHTML=`
    <tr><td>Payback Period</td><td>${pb}</td></tr>
    <tr><td>Discounted Payback Period</td><td>${dpb}</td></tr>
    <tr><td>Rate of Return / IRR</td><td>${(irr*100).toFixed(2)}%</td></tr>
    <tr class="${npv>=0?'positive':'negative'}"><td>NPV @ ${n('discount').toFixed(2)}%</td><td>${fmt(npv)}</td></tr>
    <tr class="${pi>=1?'positive':'negative'}"><td>Profitability Index</td><td>${pi.toFixed(2)}</td></tr>`;

  document.getElementById('kNPV').textContent=fmt(npv);
  document.getElementById('kIRR').textContent=(irr*100).toFixed(2)+'%';
  document.getElementById('kPayback').textContent=pb;
  document.getElementById('kPI').textContent=pi.toFixed(2);

  buildSteps();
  buildEssbase();
}

function buildSteps(){
  if(!model)return;
  document.getElementById('calcSteps').innerHTML=`
    <h3>Calculation Walkthrough</h3>
    <div class="step"><b>Initial investment:</b> Cash outflow = <b>${fmt(n('initial'))}</b></div>
    <div class="step"><b>Year 1 Present Value:</b> ${fmt(model.cfs[0])} ÷ (1 + ${n('discount')}%)¹ = <b>${fmt(model.rows[1].pv)}</b></div>
    <div class="step"><b>Total PV of Inflows:</b> Sum of discounted Year 1–5 inflows = <b>${fmt(model.pvInflows)}</b></div>
    <div class="step"><b>NPV:</b> PV of Inflows − Initial Investment = ${fmt(model.pvInflows)} − ${fmt(n('initial'))} = <b>${fmt(model.npv)}</b></div>
    <div class="step"><b>Profitability Index:</b> PV of Inflows ÷ Initial Investment = <b>${model.pi.toFixed(2)}</b></div>
    <div class="step"><b>IRR:</b> Approximate discount rate where NPV = 0 = <b>${(model.irr*100).toFixed(2)}%</b></div>`;
}

function toggleCalc(){if(!model){alert('Please click Calculate first.');return;}document.getElementById('calcSteps').classList.toggle('show')}
function toggleEssbase(){if(!model){alert('Please click Calculate first.');return;}document.getElementById('essbasePanel').classList.toggle('show')}

function buildEssbase(){
  document.getElementById('essbaseCode').textContent=
`/* Sample Oracle Essbase / Planning Capital Investment Logic */

FIX("Plan","Capital Investment")

  "Net Cash Movement" =
      "Cash In" - "Cash Out";

  "Discount Factor" =
      1 / @POWER(1 + "Discount Rate", "Year Number");

  "Present Value" =
      "Net Cash Movement" * "Discount Factor";

  "NPV" =
      @SUM("Present Value");

  "Profitability Index" =
      "PV of Future Cash Inflows" / "Initial Investment";

ENDFIX

/* IRR and Payback are commonly handled through
   dedicated business logic, Groovy, Smart View,
   or external calculation routines. */`;
}

function exportExcel(){
  if(!model){alert('Please click Calculate first.');return;}
  const t1=document.getElementById('resultTable').outerHTML;
  const t2=document.getElementById('summaryTableWrap').innerHTML;
  const blob=new Blob([`<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><meta charset="UTF-8"></head><body><h2>Capital Investment Appraisal</h2>${t1}<br>${t2}</body></html>`],{type:'application/vnd.ms-excel'});
  const url=URL.createObjectURL(blob),a=document.createElement('a');
  a.href=url;a.download='Capital_Investment_Appraisal_Simulator.xls';
  document.body.appendChild(a);a.click();a.remove();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url),1000);
}

function resetAll(){
  Object.entries(defaults).forEach(([id,val])=>document.getElementById(id).value=val);
  model=null;
  ['kNPV','kIRR','kPayback','kPI'].forEach(id=>document.getElementById(id).textContent='–');
  document.getElementById('tbody').innerHTML='<tr><td colspan="7" style="text-align:center;padding:28px;color:#64748b;">Click <b>Calculate</b> to generate the investment appraisal.</td></tr>';
  document.getElementById('summaryBody').innerHTML='<tr><td>Payback Period</td><td>–</td></tr><tr><td>Discounted Payback Period</td><td>–</td></tr><tr><td>Rate of Return / IRR</td><td>–</td></tr><tr><td>NPV</td><td>–</td></tr><tr><td>Profitability Index</td><td>–</td></tr>';
  document.getElementById('calcSteps').classList.remove('show');
  document.getElementById('essbasePanel').classList.remove('show');
  document.getElementById('calcSteps').innerHTML='';
  document.getElementById('essbaseCode').textContent='';
}
</script>
</body>
</html>
